verdict.rationale: Listing and cleanly removing installed skills is a fair question for an agent skill pack like gstack, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only installing and upgrading: it detects global vs vendored installs, uses a git-clone-and-copy model, and dev mode symlinks skills. Nothing documents a command to list installed skills, an uninstall path, or cleanup of orphaned files or injected instructions; the learnings-pruning feature concerns session learnings, not installed skills.
